title: Owens declares war on the US government: poltergeist attacks on Navy vessels
place_text: United States (Navy vessels, nuclear power plants)

tellings.quote: he said, "I'm declaring war against the United States government." And I would get newspaper clippings of poltergeist attacks on Navy vessels

plain: Between about 1980 and 1983, a self-proclaimed psychic named Ted Owens announced, "I'm declaring war against the United States government," and soon after came reports of poltergeist attacks, unexplained disturbances, on Navy ships and nuclear power plants. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic claims who knew Owens, tells this and says he would receive newspaper clippings of those attacks. The suggestion is that Owens could cause such events with his mind.
